entries.reason: a change request on a list of collections, of iOS 8; the claim is about the release, and the release's albums are one flat level: the only way it makes an album is -[ALAssetsLibrary addAssetsGroupAlbumWithName:resultBlock:failureBlock:] (ALAssetsLibrary.h:105, measured at first-rung 5.0), it takes no parent, and the word "parent" appears in no declaration of its AssetsLibrary.framework headers but a comment about parental controls. There is no list to put a collection in and no album to put one inside, so a collection list of this release is a list of the albums themselves and every member of this class -- creating one, deleting a list, adding a child collection -- has nothing to act on
